summary: I reduced the first draft mainly by deleting whole optional sentences, with an estimated net cut of about 655 words. The cuts fall on secondary reflections, catalogue extensions, the colonial-Boston paragraph, and descriptive redundancies. The full school-walk sequence, all eight protected excerpts, the essential motifs and the ending remain. Three small attribution repairs were added.
